evidence_boundary: Local source, real isolated PostgreSQL and integration proof. HTTP owner responses and metrics are test fixtures. No hosted deployment, production principal provisioning, real capital or permission activation was performed. Independent exact-head review and supervisor merge remain required.

1.implementation: fixed_actions applies every matching 2026-07-05 score condition; ask_agent accepts rationale only for preselected persona/action pairs and retains factual explanations on omission, malformed output or outage.

2.implementation: Research/tool advice POSTs draft tool_profile patches with recorded session, active base and ranking evidence. Retrain reads exact tenant/binding/paper-runtime virtual books, selects the weakest active member by observed Sharpe and posts the existing Evolution pool-member proposal. Reduction IDs/evidence are forwarded in paper allocation pool_health.recommendation_inputs at quarter close; Capital retains target calculation authority. Freeze/suspend/retire use existing legal lifecycle proposals; unsupported transitions retain an explicit routing reason. Suspend maps to frozen.

3.implementation: Existing trial_admission panel gains required red-team participation for paper_canary_candidacy scope. The evaluator requires sourced conclusions from risk and red team plus a published committee memo bound to persona, tenant and exact ranking snapshot. It includes memo content/ref in the candidacy digest/subject before operator proposal. BFF digest readback and promotion review expose this evidence.

4.implementation: Nonfinite, out-of-range or missing overall/component scores create no recommendations; last_run persists the reason. Snapshot admission may reject invalid numbers earlier. Missing member books, owner credentials/session/harness base or panel evidence keep the corresponding route unsubmitted with a reason.

5.implementation: test_real_postgres_ranking_to_each_owner_over_http calls real run_once, paper_cycle_once and promotion_once, with real Rankings/PostgreSQL and only owner HTTP faked. It reaches every advice action, weakest member, closed-quarter paper allocation and panel-bound candidacy; schema-validates harness and Evolution payloads and rejects a model attempt to change action. Existing Governance integration exercises real main(), PostgreSQL/CAS, BFF inbox, approval/rejection and review readback.
